prompt.en: In which year were Aboriginal people granted the vote in Canada?
prompt.fr: En quelle année les Autochtones ont-ils obtenu le droit de vote au Canada?

explanation.en: In 1960, Aboriginal people in Canada gained the right to vote.
explanation.fr: En 1960, les Autochtones du Canada ont obtenu le droit de vote.

source.quote: Aboriginal people were granted the vote in 1960.

verification.evidence: Aboriginal people were granted the vote in 1960. Today every citizen over the age of 18 may vote.
